headline: More than half of Portuguese people feel a loss of purchasing power due to rising cost of living
summary: Fifty-three percent of Portuguese consumers say they lost purchasing power over the past year, and 77% show high concern about costs. Many are comparing prices and choosing store brands.
why: Household purchasing power shapes consumer spending, which drives retail and consumer-goods revenues in the Portuguese economy.
